title: Decoupling Vision and Language: Codebook Anchored Visual Adaptation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of a visual adaptation method for Large Vision-Language Models. While it uses 'faithfulness' as an evaluation metric, it defines this term strictly in a technical sense regarding how well the model's reasoning is grounded in the provided image (i.e., avoiding hallucinations), rather than relating it to religious faith, spiritual traditions, or ethical benchmarking.
